name: ascendc-native-subagent-flows
description: K-Search AscendC Claude native subagent flows.

stages.name: code-reader
stages.instruction: Read the candidate project and write CODE_MAP.md. Do not edit source files.

stages.name: plan
stages.instruction: Read CODE_MAP.md and the attempt context, then write IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

stages.name: codegen
stages.instruction: Read CODE_MAP.md and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, edit the project according to the plan, and update CODE_MAP.md if project contracts changed.

stages.name: reviewer
stages.instruction: Review the edited project, CODE_MAP.md, and IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, then write REVIEW_NOTES.md.

eval_failure_repair.name: ascendc-eval-failure-repair
eval_failure_repair.description: Repair flow triggered by Python after benchmark/evaluation failure.

stages.name: bug-fixer
stages.instruction: Read the Python evaluation failure context from the base prompt, inspect the current project, and make the minimal source edits needed to fix the failure. Update CODE_MAP.md if project contracts changed.

stages.name: reviewer
stages.instruction: Review the repair, CODE_MAP.md, and the failure context, then write REVIEW_NOTES.md before Python re-evaluates.
